newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 1.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
A lengthy article says Wang Dan's trial was held according to the law and that the court's verdict was completely correct.
Japan's Mitsubishi Corp and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd win bid to supply $180 million worth of generating equipment to Sanhe power plant in north China.
A senior official urges more funds and work on eliminating poverty in China by the end of the century.
China's economy will maintain annual growth of 7.5 percent from 2000 to 2010.

The China Securities Regulatory Commission warns against spreading rumours to manipulate the stock market and vows to revoke the licences of institutions found guilty of creating or spreading false information.
